# envless/env

> 标签: config, dotenv, encrypted secrets, env, env vars, environment variables, envless, laravel, runtime, secret management, secrets, symfony

## 简介

The Envless runtime for PHP. Loads your environment from Envless when your app starts, decrypts it on the machine that runs it, and hands it to your code typed, without writing plaintext to disk.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。
